verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS invoicing product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a telemetry, analytics, or tracking opt-out. The security claims (PCI-DSS, SSL, 2FA) are a different capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
